notes: Every template runs against a public demo backend out of the box; the env vars only re-point it at your own Shopware instance and belong in a .env file in the project root (vue-starter-template ships a .env.template to copy). To start a project: run scaffoldCommand, install dependencies with pnpm (Node per the node field), then run the package.json dev script (pnpm dev) and open http://localhost:<devPort>. devCommand and buildCommand show what the dev and build scripts do - run the scripts, not these strings. typeGeneration regenerates the API types from your own instance, which is what brings in installed extensions' types; run its loadSchemaCommand first, the script alone falls back to the published default types.

templates.purpose: Supported starting point for a new storefront.

NUXT_PUBLIC_SHOPWARE_ENDPOINT.description: Store API endpoint of your Shopware instance, e.g. https://your-shop.com/store-api/.

NUXT_PUBLIC_SHOPWARE_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Sales Channel access token (Shopware admin: Settings > Sales Channel > API access).

NUXT_PUBLIC_SHOPWARE_DEV_STOREFRONT_URL.description: Optional. Storefront domain registered in your Sales Channel; without it customer registration fails in local development.

NUXT_SHOPWARE_ENDPOINT.description: Optional. Private endpoint for server-side requests when it differs from the public one.

OPENAPI_JSON_URL.description: Base URL of the Shopware instance: NUXT_PUBLIC_SHOPWARE_ENDPOINT without its /store-api suffix (trailing slash or not).

OPENAPI_ACCESS_KEY.description: Sales Channel access key: the same value as NUXT_PUBLIC_SHOPWARE_ACCESS_TOKEN.
